newsitem.title: USA: Church worker to pay back over $1 million.
newsitem.headline: Church worker to pay back over $1 million.

text.p: A New York City woman admitted on Monday to stealing more than $1 million from a Roman Catholic Church diocese in a plea deal that will require her to pay all the money back, prosecutors said.
Vincenza Bologna, 53, a church employee for more than than 30 years, will avoid prison time under the arrangement, said Charles Hynes, the Brooklyn, New York, District Attorney.
As manager of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Brooklyn pension office, Bologna admitted stealing more than $1 million between 1990 and 1996 and depositing the money in her own personal bank account.
She pleaded guilty to second degree grand larceny.
Bologna will be sentenced to five years probation and 1,000 hours of community service, and she agreed to sign an order of restitution for $1.2 million, Hynes said.
"The evidence in this case disclosed a pattern of greed by a worker of long employment who betrayed her trust," he said.
